task: Estimate oral temperature measured in monitor mode from facial infrared measurements and environment information.
context: device identifies FLIR or ICI. Facial fields ending _mean are means across available image rounds, in Celsius: right/left canthus maxima and averages; RC/LC eye-corner regions; RCC/LCC small eye-corner regions; canthi extended eye region; FH forehead regions; T_Max face maximum; OR mouth-region infrared readings. T_offset_mean is the blackbody correction offset. Gender/Age/Ethnicity are categories; T_atm: Celsius; Humidity: percent; Distance: metres. Both oral-thermometer fields are excluded from input; infrared mouth-region readings are distinct from oral thermometer labels.
